description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 09.03.2015 to 15.03.2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment of new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it names the Director General of Customs, this is only to establish the authority issuing the regulation, not to announce a personnel change or assign detailed portfolio responsibilities to that individual.
